# launchR

> launchR starts an R package with tests, CI and GitHub files in place, or adds ready-made CI and a quality gate to a package that already exists. It is free and open source (MIT), runs in the browser, and needs no terminal.

launchR builds a zip in the visitor's browser. There is no account, and nothing typed into the form leaves the browser. It supports packages hosted on GitHub.

## Start a new R package

- [Start your package](https://launch-r.web.app/#start): answer four questions and download a zip named after your package.
- [How it works](https://launch-r.web.app/#kit): what the setup puts in place.

## Add CI to an existing package

- [Set up an existing package](https://launch-r.web.app/#yours): take the CI files only; `R/`, `tests/` and `DESCRIPTION` are left alone.

## Use the source

- [launchR on GitHub](https://github.com/insightsurge/launchR): the template, the shared workflows and a command line that makes the same package.

## Learn

- [R Engineering Playbook](https://insightsurge-dev.web.app/blog): articles on engineering practice for R packages.

## Optional

- [Full text for agents](https://launch-r.web.app/llms-full.txt): everything above in one file, with the checks and plans listed.
